findings.title: IDOR - Access to First User Profile Reveals Flag
findings.description: The application exposes the first user's profile via an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability at /profile/:id. The first user's MongoDB ObjectId can be derived from the application start timestamp exposed via /starttime. Accessing the first user's profile reveals a hidden flag that is only shown when the profile ID matches the first user's ID.
